meta_description:
1,049 likes, 31 comments - financebyanmoll on October 2, 2026: "We humans are always driven by narratives and sentiments.

Right now, market sentiment is weak. There’s fear, negativity and pessimism everywhere.

But if you think exactly like everyone else, you might miss the opportunities being created right now.

I’m not saying everything looks good or that the market will start rallying from here.

But when pessimism becomes extreme, that’s usually when you should start looking at the other side and searching for opportunities.

As Warren Buffett said, “Be fearful when others are greedy and greedy when others are fearful.”

So don’t get completely swayed by the narrative that markets are bearish and everything is bad.

Always look at the other side too.".
